cards.headline: Markets closed for the weekend
cards.body: US equity markets are shut for the weekend, so the tape is frozen at the previous session's close. Everything below reflects that last close — not live trading — and refreshes when the market reopens.

cards.headline: Last close: broad selling, 26% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX +0.17% · WTI -5.01% · Brent -4.85% · NatGas -1.06%. At the last close, 26% of 68 energy names were green — broad selling. Grid, Storage & Electrification did the heavy lifting at +1.76%.

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Nuclear & Uranium lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +1.76%; weakest is Nuclear & Uranium at -2.38%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: SMR is the standout at -8.52%
cards.body: Leaders: ETN +3.74%, VRT +3.27%, PWR +3.27%, TRGP +2.50%, KMI +1.69%. Laggards: SMR -8.52%, BE -5.39%, FLNC -4.44%, ARRY -4.25%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.

cards.headline: BE moving on no clear catalyst
cards.body: BE is -5.39% with no fresh headline this cycle — attention without a story. Volume, not news, is doing the work.
